articles.titleOriginal: A Review of the Present State of Data for Metformin as a Geroprotective Drug
articles.summaryOriginal: Researchers here review the present state of research and use of metformin as a geroprotective drug, intended to modestly slow aging. They are largely on point, if somewhat too accepting of the quality of the existing human data.
